description: FREE check of a trade thesis, no wallet and no payment. Send the thesis in the user's own words and say whether it is a prediction-market bet or a perp/spot trade. Returns PASS, WAIT or FAIL with the reasons, the same verdict the paid audit computes (same rules, same engine). It does NOT write a receipt: nothing is attested on-chain and nothing can be shown to a counterparty. For a receipt use verify_pm_trade or verify_perp_trade (2.00 USDC via x402). USE THIS TOOL when the user wants to test a thesis before trading and the client cannot pay, or before deciding whether a paid receipt is worth it. Shared daily limit across all callers; when it is used up the result says so. A verdict grades whether the reasoning is stated, falsifiable and bounded. It does not predict the outcome and is not advice.

kind.description: prediction_market for a bet on a Kalshi or Polymarket style market; perp_or_spot for a perpetual or spot trade.

thesis.description: The thesis in the user's own words: the venue and market or instrument, the side, the size or price, the reason, the source of any odds or data, and what would prove it wrong. Do not rewrite or improve it; the check reads what the user actually wrote.

name: check_thesis

attested.description: Always false: no receipt is written

free.description: Always true: this tool never charges

status.description: OK (a verdict follows), LIMIT_REACHED (free checks used up for today) or UNAVAILABLE

verdict.description: PASS, WAIT, FAIL, or REFUSED_SCOPE when the thesis was sent as the wrong kind

title: Check a Trade Thesis for Free
